map.口腔癌（TNM）筛查工具 使用指南: Oral Cancer (TNM) Screening Tool User Guide
map.录入口腔病灶的 T、N、M 分期信息与症状，按 TNM 标准给出分期筛查结论与就: Enter T, N, M staging information and symptoms for an oral lesion and get a staging screening conclusion and medical advice under the TNM standard; results are reference only and do not replace pathological diagnosis.
map.口腔黏膜白斑伴溃疡久不愈，录入病灶大小与淋巴结情况，工具给出分期筛查提示。: Oral mucosal leukoplakia with an ulcer that will not heal: enter lesion size and lymph node status and the tool gives staging screening hints.
map.颈部无痛肿块，输入 N 分期信息，提示需排查区域淋巴结转移。: A painless neck lump: enter N staging information and the tool flags the need to check for regional lymph node metastasis.
map.出现远处症状，录入 M 信息并强烈建议尽快就医。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛: If distant symptoms appear, enter M information and strongly recommend seeing a doctor promptly. (Results are for oral health education and self-screening reference only, not a substitute for oral examination, periapical films/CBCT and other imaging assessment, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists and periodontists; for toothache, bleeding gums, ulcers that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or bite discomfort, see a stomatology department promptly.)
map.：输入：T2（肿瘤 2~4cm）、N0（无淋巴结）、M0（无远处转移）\n输出：:
: input: T2 (tumour 2-4 cm), N0 (no lymph nodes), M0 (no distant metastasis)
Output: clinical stage II, recommend prompt biopsy and imaging assessment at an oral and maxillofacial surgery department; any ulcer lasting over 2 weeks, mucosal induration or leukoplakia needs medical attention.
map.正畸力与牙移动评估器: Orthodontic Force and Tooth Movement Assessor
map.T、N、M 分别代表什么？: What do T, N and M stand for?
map.T 原发肿瘤大小/侵犯，N 区域淋巴结转移，M 远处转移；三者组合决定临床分期，: T is primary tumour size / invasion, N is regional lymph node metastasis, M is distant metastasis; the three combined determine clinical stage and guide treatment.
map.筛查工具能确诊口腔癌吗？: Can the screening tool diagnose oral cancer?
map.不能。本工具仅按录入信息做分期提示，确诊必须靠活检病理；溃疡久不愈、黏膜异常请立: No. This tool only gives staging hints from the entered information; diagnosis must rest on biopsy pathology; for ulcers that will not heal or abnormal mucosa see a doctor immediately.
map.口腔溃疡 >2 周不愈、白斑/红斑、硬结、颈部肿块、麻木或张口受限，应尽早到口腔: Oral ulcers that do not heal for more than 2 weeks, white or red patches, induration, neck lumps, numbness or restricted opening should be taken to an oral and maxillofacial surgery department promptly.
